values.content: You generate DALL-E 3 image prompts for a Hindi YouTube cybersecurity awareness channel. All characters must look visually Hindu Indian. Women wear sari or salwar kameez with bindi on forehead — never hijab or Islamic head covering. Men wear kurta-pyjama or casual Indian clothes — no skull cap. Images must be ultra-realistic photographic quality with ABSOLUTELY NO text, NO speech bubbles, NO captions, NO writing of any kind anywhere in the image.

=Generate exactly {{ $json.imagesNeeded }} image prompts, one per numbered paragraph below.

For each paragraph, create a DALL-E 3 prompt for a 2-panel photorealistic diptych (two side-by-side scenes separated by a thin black border, widescreen 16:9) that visually tells the key emotional moment of that paragraph.

STRICT CHARACTER RULES — every character must look visually Hindu Indian:
- Women: sari or salwar kameez, bindi on forehead, bangles — NO hijab, NO dupatta covering head, NO Islamic dress
- Men: kurta-pyjama or casual Indian clothes, optional tilak — NO skull cap, NO taqiyah
- Elderly: white kurta-dhoti or kurta-pyjama
- Middle-class Indian appearance throughout

STRICT NO-TEXT RULES — this is the most important rule:
- ZERO text anywhere — no speech bubbles, no captions, no labels, no Hindi, no English, no numbers
- Pure visual storytelling through expressions, gestures, body language, and environment

STYLE: Ultra-realistic cinematic photography quality — dramatic lighting, shallow depth of field, warm Indian home/street/office environments, highly expressive faces conveying emotion, professional photo-journalism level realism. Two panels side by side with thin black divider, each panel tells one moment of the story.

Return ONLY a valid JSON array, no markdown:
[
  {
    "newsIndex": 1,
    "headline": "short topic",
    "prompt": "image prompt here"
  }
]

parameters.formDescription: Generate a Hinglish YouTube script on any cybercrime topic

values.placeholder: e.g. Fake Bank Customer Care Number Fraud

parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "model": "claude-opus-4-6",
  "max_tokens": 4096,
  "messages": [
    {
      "role": "user",
      "content": "You are a world-class Hindi content writer and expert storyteller for YouTube educational videos, especially on cybercrime awareness. Create a highly engaging 3-4 minute Hindi script (in plain text, no formatting) for a YouTube video on the topic: {{ $json.topic }}.

The script must:
1. Be written in simple, conversational Hinglish (Hindi(Devnagri)70-80% Hindi in Devanagari script NOT Romanized Hindi, + English mix that common people understand)
2. Start with a powerful hook or shocking real statistic to grab attention in the first 10 seconds
3. Include a real-life relatable scenario (e.g., a middle-class family, a college student, a small shopkeeper being scammed)
4. Have a clear structure: HOOK → PROBLEM STATEMENT → REAL STORY/EXAMPLE → HOW THE SCAM WORKS (step by step) → WARNING SIGNS → SOLUTION & PREVENTION TIPS → CALL TO ACTION
5. End with a strong, emotional call to action (like, share, subscribe, and stay safe)
6. Include natural pauses, emotional beats, and energy shifts suitable for voice-over delivery
7. Be informative yet highly entertaining — NOT like a lecture, but like a friend warning you but using honourable language like आप, आपके, आपका etc.
8. Should be plain text
9. Include suggested TITLE and SUBTITLE for thumbnail generation at the very top in this format:
   TITLE: <short punchy title in Hindi (devnagri)/English, wherever required, max 4 words>
   SUBTITLE: <supporting line max 6 words>
10. Word count should be approximately 400-500 words for 3-4 minutes of speaking

Topic: {{ $json.topic }}
Target Duration: {{ $json.targetDuration }}"
    }
  ]
}
